A surfer turning across a green wave with white water breaking behind
An instructor and a student on the sand, knees bent in pop-up stance on a blue and a red soft-top
One surfer paddling towards a low aqua wave, seen from behind, with a pale sky above the horizon
Sanjee smiling as he walks out of the shallows with a surfboard under his arm, a rust-coloured cliff behind him

An empty sand beach with wooden posts in the foreground, white water breaking on the left and palms running down the coast under a deep blue sky
Four beach dogs in silhouette on the sand, looking out to sea at a red sun on the horizon
Sun high behind thin cloud, silver light on the shore waves and on the wet sand
Three thatched parasols on the sand with lines of surf breaking behind them under a grey sky
Tall palms on a grassy headland with a path and beach stalls, clean lines of swell coming in behind
Footprints on wet gold sand beside a lacy line of foam at the water's edge
